note: Hawaii prints no aye list, so the fetcher counts every sitting member not named as a no or excused as an aye. This file says who was NOT sitting on a date. The 2026 people file lists 53 representatives and 26 senators for 51 and 25 seats because it keeps the members each appointee replaced. Dates come from the Governor's appointment releases and the chambers' own announcements, never from where the votes seem to stop.

windows.note: Rep. Gene Ward, HD-018. Retirement effective March 31, 2025; died April 4, 2025. Never sat in 2026.
Rep. Joe Gedeon, HD-018. Appointed by Gov. Green May 28, 2025 to the late Gene Ward's seat; sworn in after the 2025 session adjourned, so he sat for every 2026 floor vote.

Rep. Daniel Holt, HD-028. Friday, February 13, 2026 was his final day in the House (Hawaii News Now, Feb. 13, 2026) before becoming special assistant to the chair of the Department of Land and Natural Resources.
Rep. Michael 'Cov' Ratcliffe, HD-028. Appointed April 13, 2026; took the oath April 14, 2026 in the House chamber (Governor's release).
Sen. Henry Aquino, SD-019. Retirement took effect November 30, 2025 (Governor's December 3, 2025 release). Never sat in 2026.
Sen. Rachele Fernandez Lamosao, SD-019. Appointed December 3, 2025; sworn in January 21, 2026, opening day (Governor's release). Her 2025 House votes (HD-036) are in the 2025 dataset, session 2175.
Rep. Daisy Hartsfield, HD-036. Appointed January 12, 2026; sworn in January 21, 2026, opening day (Governor's release).

vacancies.note: Between Holt's resignation and Ratcliffe's oath the House had 50 members.
Between Aquino's retirement and Lamosao's oath; no floor vote falls in this window (the session opened January 21, 2026).
Lamosao's House seat until Hartsfield's oath; no floor vote falls in this window.
